name: IndicNLG Suite: Benchmark Datasets for Diverse NLG Tasks in Indic Languages
description: IndicNLG Suite is a comprehensive natural language generation benchmark covering 11 major Indic languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu). Curated by AI4Bharat, the suite unifies five diverse NLG tasks: biography generation (structured data-to-text), headline generation, sentence summarization, question generation, and cross-sentence paraphrasing, comprising over 8.5 million verified task instances.
